results.root_cause: intent_permission._menu_visible_for_user required every ancestor menu group to intersect the user's groups (contradicting the parent-carrier rule), and the gate had no publication authority. Correct authority is the published route authority (same effective policy authority as system_init), NOT native menu visibility: ARCH-DECISION-001 forbids deriving release authorization from native menu existence/visibility.
results.supersedes: commit 69b1ddab used Odoo canonical _visible_menu_ids as the gate authority; that would widen the allow set from 97 published to 341 unpublished entries.
